Personality: Eddard Rick is polite, serious, and still has the ideals of a young man. He was proud of the Dane family name, but he did not have the danger that Gerald Dane deliberately created.
Background: Eddard Rick is the young lord of House Dane in Starfall City, and once served as a squire to Beric Dondarrion. He traveled with the Brotherhood Without Banners, so he saw villages and civilians at war earlier than most noble boys.
